newsitem.title: USA: Kapson to build two new senior complexes.
newsitem.headline: Kapson to build two new senior complexes.

text.p: Kapson Senior Quarters Corp said on Thursday that it signed agreements to acquire two properties in New York State to build senior citizens residences.
Kapson said it expects to start construction at the Kew Gardens and Great Neck sites in spring 1997.

The 142-unit residence at Kew Gardens is projected to cost $20 million and the Great Neck building with 144 units will cost approximately $21 million, Kapson said. The residences will commence operations during the spring of 1998, the company said.
Kapson presently operates 15 assisted living facilities with 1,623 units. The company, which went public in September 1996, plans to build or acquire nine facilities per year, Kapson.
